condition_0: SELECT CASE WHEN (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "CUSTOMER" WHERE (("CUSTOMER_ID" = CAST(? AS INT)) AND ("STATUS" = 'ACTIVE')))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
insert_2: INSERT INTO "ORDERS" ("CUSTOMER_ID", "ORDER_DATE", "STATUS", "CHANNEL", "TOTAL_AMOUNT", "CURRENCY", "ORDER_ID") VALUES (CAST(? AS INT), LOCALTIMESTAMP, 'NEW', CAST(? AS VARCHAR(10)), 0, 'AED', CAST(? AS INT))
